dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Go on, Nam. You're on slide four now.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡoʊ ˈɑːn, ˈnɑːm. jʊr ɑːn ˈslaɪd ˈfɔːr ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: As you can see in this chart, 65% of students use English on social media every day.
dialogue.reading: əz juː kən ˈsiː ɪn ðɪs ˈtʃɑːrt, ˈsɪksti ˈfaɪv pərˈsɛnt əv ˈstuːdənts ˈjuːz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɑːn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. And what does the next slide show?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ənd ˈwʌt dʌz ðə ˈnɛkst ˈslaɪd ˈʃoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's a graph of how many hours students spend online each day. As you can see, it keeps going up.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ə ˈɡræf əv ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈaʊərz ˈstuːdənts ˈspɛnd ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈiːtʃ ˈdeɪ. əz juː kən ˈsiː, ɪt ˈkiːps ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈʌp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Are those figures from your own survey?
dialogue.reading: ər ðoʊz ˈfɪɡjərz frəm jʊr ˈoʊn ˈsɜːrveɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, they're from a national survey. As I mentioned at the start, my survey was quite small.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðɛr frəm ə ˈnæʃənəl ˈsɜːrveɪ. əz aɪ ˈmɛnʃənd ət ðə ˈstɑːrt, maɪ ˈsɜːrveɪ wʌz ˈkwaɪt ˈsmɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then you should say where the statistics come from.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn juː ʃʊd ˈseɪ wɛr ðə stəˈtɪstɪks ˈkʌm ˈfrʌm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'll put the source under the graph.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈpʊt ðə ˈsɔːrs ˈʌndər ðə ˈɡræf.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. And this diagram? It looks a bit complicated.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ənd ðɪs ˈdaɪəɡræm? ɪt ˈlʊks ə ˈbɪt ˈkɑːmplɪkeɪtɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It shows the four steps of my research. As you can see, I started with interviews.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈʃoʊz ðə ˈfɔːr ˈstɛps əv maɪ ˈriːsɜːrtʃ. əz juː kən ˈsiː, aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd wɪð ˈɪntərvjuːz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Can you make it simpler? The audience won't have much time to read it.
dialogue.reading: kən juː ˈmeɪk ɪt ˈsɪmpələr? ði ˈɔːdiəns ˈwoʊnt ˈhæv ˈmʌtʃ ˈtaɪm tə ˈriːd ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good point. I'll use bigger text and fewer words.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈpɔɪnt. aɪl ˈjuːz ˈbɪɡər ˈtɛkst ənd ˈfjuːər ˈwɜːrdz.
